recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-40475 in core FHIR unless a future issue changes the broader Device/DeviceDefinition conformsTo model.
issue_request: FHIR-40475 is a Published/Persuasive R5 OO change request asking to change DeviceDefinition.conformsTo.category from Coding to CodeableConcept after the FHIR-39084 conformsTo revisions.
initial_application: FHIR-39084 introduced DeviceDefinition.conformsTo.category as Coding in commit ac8c3aa2b3b. Commit 2cfdd9c8375 then changed DeviceDefinition.conformsTo.category from Coding to CodeableConcept and adjusted the definition, matching the FHIR-40475 request even though the commit message did not name the Jira key.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists devicedefinition=DeviceDefinition, so source/devicedefinition/structuredefinition-DeviceDefinition.xml is build-scope source. OO minutes from 2023-02-16 record the motion for FHIR-40475 alongside companion issue FHIR-40476. A bounded Zulip search found no directly relevant conflicting discussion, and the checked R5 historical generated resource surface also shows CodeableConcept.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source hunk was necessary because the active StructureDefinition already implements the requested datatype.

related_jiras.note: The antecedent conformsTo restructuring introduced the category element as Coding before the later FHIR-40475 correction.
Companion Device.conformsTo.category datatype issue voted in the same OO motion; it was not decided by this seed audit.
